# Best Case Studio

> Best Case Studio is a two-person studio (Jon McGreevy and Jessie McGreevy) that produces customer case studies for B2B SaaS companies. Two productised offers: Optimise (list $1,500, currently $500 at the founding rate) and Build (list $2,500, currently $1,250 for the first 10 founding clients). Turnaround is 14 business days.

## Two ways to work together

### Optimise — $500 per case study (founding rate; list price $1,500)

For case studies that aren't earning their place on your website. We rebuild an existing case study to the Citable Case Study standard — the version AI cites and Google ranks — supply the JSON-LD schema markup, and hand you an implementation guide with step-by-step instructions for publishing it on your exact tech stack. Every case study is scored against the 6 Citable dimensions before it ships. Support never expires. One consolidated round of revisions. 14 business days.

### Build — $1,250 per case study (founding rate for the first 10 clients; list price $2,500)

Full case study production from scratch. Includes:

- 30-minute customer interview, scheduled and recorded by us.
- A citable case study written from the interview — built to get quoted by AI (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity), ranked by Google, and to never read as AI-written.
- A companion video, edited from the same interview.
- JSON-LD schema and structured data.
- An implementation guide with step-by-step instructions for publishing it on your exact tech stack.
- Every case study scored against the 6 Citable dimensions before it ships.
- Support that never expires — ask a question a year later and we'll still answer.
- 14 business days from interview to first drafts. One consolidated round of revisions.
- Volume pricing on three or more.

## Who we are

- Jon McGreevy — founder and lead. Seven years working with B2B SaaS on positioning, content, and conversion. Runs every interview, writes every word, edits every video. Writes about trust and credibility in B2B SaaS at https://jonmcgreevy.com and https://jonmcgreevy.substack.com. Hosts the "SaaSy as F**k" podcast.
- Jessie McGreevy — operations. Scheduling, logistics, customer-side coordination, on-time delivery.

No outsourcing, no AI-generated content. The two people you meet on the discovery call are the two people who deliver the work.

## Who it's for

- B2B SaaS companies who want named-customer case studies. Any geography.
- Founders, marketing leads, and sales leaders who want a productized service rather than a quarter-long agency engagement.

## Who it's not for

- Pre-product-market-fit startups without paying customers.
- Companies who want anonymous/persona-style case studies.
- Buyers expecting AI-generated content.

## Pricing

- Optimise: $500 USD per case study at the current founding rate (list price $1,500). Rewrites an existing case study into the Citable Case Study format.
- Build: $1,250 USD per case study for the first 10 founding clients (list price $2,500). Full production from customer interview to final deliverables. When the 10 founding slots are gone, the price returns to $2,500 permanently.
- Volume discounts on three or more.

## Case study examples

Worked examples of the Citable Case Study format — each produced for a real client and published as a portfolio piece:

- Extrovert (AI-powered LinkedIn engagement): Mila at COMMIT added 4,000+ LinkedIn connections in 2.5 years. https://bestcasestud.io/examples/
- SaasyDB (SaaS lead database): LeadForce Solutions sourced SaaS leads that appear in no other database, at a 3% cold-email reply rate. https://bestcasestud.io/examples/saasydb-leadforce-solutions/
- Measurable Energy (clean energy tech): St Peters School cut its energy bills by £7,000–£8,000 a year with AI smart sockets. https://bestcasestud.io/examples/measurable-energy-st-peters-school/
- TaxValet (sales tax compliance): Stealth Fitness offloaded 50-state sales tax compliance at roughly a quarter of the in-house cost. https://bestcasestud.io/examples/taxvalet-stealth-fitness/
